equipment.name: Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI)
equipment.specifications: 3 Tesla of magnetic field and designed for animal use.

equipment.name: Vibrating-sample magnetometer (VSM)
equipment.specifications: Measures DC magnetization characteristics of materials by changing temperature and magnetic fields.

equipment.name: Transmission electron microscopy (TEM)
equipment.specifications: ARM200F (JEOL. Ltd., Cold field emission-Transmission Electron Microscope) is equipped with two Cs-corrector, atomic resolution of 78 pm in STEM mode, energy-dispersive x-ray spectroscopy (EDX) and electron energy-loss spectroscopy (EELS).

equipment.name: Nuclear Magnetic Resonance (NMR)
equipment.specifications: Uses a large magnet to probe intrinsic spin properties of atomic nuclei and for structure determination of small molecules.

equipment.name: X-ray diffractometer (XRD)
equipment.specifications: Used for phase identification of a crystalline material, providing information on unit cell dimensions and orderliness.

equipment.name: Photoluminescence (PL) spectrophotometer
equipment.specifications: Uses a laser beam to capture light generated from a substance as electrons fall from excited to ground state.

equipment.name: Gas Chromatography and mass spectrometry (GC-MS)
equipment.specifications: Combines features of gas chromatography and mass spectrometry to separate and identify organic substances.

equipment.name: Inductively coupled plasma mass spectrometry (ICP-MS)
equipment.specifications: Capable of detecting periodic table of elements at concentrations as low as one part in 1015.

equipment.name: Fourier-transform infrared (FT-IR) spectrometer
equipment.specifications: Produces an infrared absorption spectrum to identify types of chemical bonds in a molecule.

equipment.name: Electron-Beam & Thermal Evaporator
equipment.specifications: Deposits various metals on the substrate with tuned deposition rate of 1 - 100 A/min.

equipment.name: Sputtering System
equipment.specifications: Deposits oxides, nitrides, and various semiconductors as a thin film layer using high-density plasma.

equipment.name: Reactive Ion Etching (RIE)
equipment.specifications: Uses chemically reactive plasma generated under low pressure to remove material deposited on wafers.

equipment.name: Probe station
equipment.specifications: Utilizes manipulators for precise positioning of thin needles to acquire electrical signals from semiconductor devices.

equipment.name: Mask Aligner
equipment.specifications: Used in photolithography process for aligning photomask to photoresist coated substrate using UV light.

equipment.name: Electron-beam lithography
equipment.specifications: For fabrication of nanodevices below 100 nm scale of resolution using a scanning electron microscope (SEM).

equipment.name: Total internal reflection fluorescence microscope (TIRF)
equipment.specifications: Images a thin region of a specimen less than 200 nanometers using an evanescent wave.

equipment.name: Confocal microscope (with STORM)
equipment.specifications: Uses a spatial pinhole to block out-of-focus light and increase spatial imaging resolution and contrast.

equipment.name: Fluorescence-Activated Cell Sorting (FACS)
equipment.specifications: Flow cytometry that rapidly separates labeled living cells based on specific fluorescence characteristics.

equipment.name: Tissue clearing system (with SMART labeling)
equipment.specifications: Series of instrumentation to clear opaque tissue to make it optically transparent in visible wavelength.

equipment.name: Microplate reader
equipment.specifications: Used to detect biological or chemical events of samples in microtiter plates.

equipment.name: 3D Bioprinter
equipment.specifications: Combines cells, growth factors, and biomaterials to fabricate biomedical parts imitating natural tissue characteristics.

equipment.name: Ultracentrifuge
equipment.specifications: Optimized for spinning a rotor at very high speeds generating acceleration as high as 1,000,000g.
